summary: Config hardening refactor verified. All 6 endpoints in scope return HTTP 200 with expected payloads. 9/9 pytest cases pass on the public URL. Login (Supabase password grant) returns a valid 3-segment JWT. GET /api/organizations/me returns 'Two Fungis Finishing' with primary_organization_id set. GET /api/command-center/dashboard returns organization_name containing 'Two Fungis' with all required keys (today_focus, projects, opportunities, recent_activity, brain_insights, quick_stats, generated_at). GET /api/production-library/seed/status returns is_seeded=true with 8+ production_items. GET /api/production-library/items returns all 8 seeded codes (DW-001..TP-002). GET /api/opportunities returns 200 with 'opportunities' list. No DNS 'Name or service not known' / 'errno -2' errors in any response body, confirming config.SUPABASE_URL is properly loaded via the new lazy Config module. Also identified and fixed one leftover from the refactor in /app/backend/server.py (see rca).

minor.issue: Fixed inline: /api/status was still using bare module-level SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY names that were removed during the config refactor. Endpoint returned 200 but with services.supabase = "error: name 'SUPABASE_URL' is not defined" and status='degraded'. Replaced with config.SUPABASE_URL / config.SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY. Now returns supabase='connected', status='healthy'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py already fixed inline: /api/status was the only remaining site using bare SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY. Consider grepping the whole backend for other bare env-var names (`grep -rn 'SUPABASE_URL\|SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY' backend/ | grep -v config\.` returns clean now).
config.py uses @cached_property so values are memoised on first access. This means changing env vars at runtime will NOT propagate. Acceptable for prod but worth documenting.
config.APP_URL default 'https://tradeos.com' silently masks a missing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Consider raising if empty in prod paths.
routes/production_library.py is 1918 lines - still worth splitting into domain/items/assemblies/seed modules (>700 line threshold, previously flagged).
JWT is still decoded with verify_signature=False across multiple routes (organizations, production_library). Security concern noted in prior iterations, not blocking.

rca of the issue: Not a bug in the requested scope - all 6 endpoints in the review returned 200 successfully out of the box. The refactor is working. During review I found a leftover /api/status endpoint in server.py (lines 155-160) still referencing module-level SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY which were removed during the refactor. This raised NameError caught by a broad except, so /api/status returned 200 but with services.supabase='error: name SUPABASE_URL is not defined' and status='degraded'. Fixed by replacing with config.SUPABASE_URL / config.SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY. Verified: /api/status now returns {"services":{"supabase":"connected"},"status":"healthy"}.
